title: Two-phase atomic resolve_args and Dispatcher panic isolation are well-designed
description: The two-phase atomicity in resolve_args (collect all resolutions read-only, then apply mutations) is correct and should be preserved — a naive single-pass approach would partially mutate args on failure. The tokio::task::spawn panic isolation in Dispatcher::dispatch is also correct and should not be changed to a direct .await — a panic in a handler would abort the connection task without it.
